messages:
Iris: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — root cause: cache fast-path accepted rotated tokens (~30s window) and audit-emitter dropped events under short bursts. I'll post owners for remediation.
Devon: Saw the repro in staging, customer hit was small but visible. Share actions pls.
Iris: Action 1: Fast-path stricter check — Owner: Devon — refuse shortcut if token_age > 20s or missing issue_stamp. Due: 2026-09-05.
Devon: :white_check_mark: I accept. Will open PR and add unit+integration tests. ETA PR by 9/3.
Iris: Action 2: Durable audit buffer + retry — Owner: Mariela — PoC local WAL forwarder then infra plan for Kafka/S3. Due: 2026-09-12.
Mariela: :white_check_mark: PoC by 9/10, will include metrics for queue length.
Iris: Action 3: Reconcile job + alerting — Owner: Mariela — hourly reconcile tokens_issued vs audit_emitted by org, alert on missing>0 for paid orgs. Due: 2026-09-08.
Mariela: noted, will work with observability.
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-5600 "fastpath-stricter-check" assigned to Devon
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-5601 "durable-audit-buffer" assigned to Mariela
Devon: Temporary mitigations applied: cache shortcut TTL reduced to 10s on canary clusters; emitter workers +1.
Iris: Also running recurrence query (90d) to see if this is a deploy-spike pattern. Will report results here. Treat as 2-week remediation sprint and update when items move to in-progress/done.
